records.words: I remember sending two sacks by accident and walking to houses without getting a word in. This says spoken answer. That is what I want to try.
Going straight to Çoban this time. I remember the proud grain reply, but I want to answer them instead of buying another sack.
Yes, there is a sentence for me this time. I came to listen is softer than what I would say, but let us hear her.
My words are there, but she has not answered them yet. The phone shows half her old reply above my words; I can read my sentence, though. I will get out of the reading view and give her time.

I got to say I came to listen at Çoban. My sentence appeared, but no answer to it yet; Yusuf has said Come in in the notebook. The clock and minutes-until-home make the waiting clearer than last time. I still want a reply I can play with. The phone has big buttons, but the fixed bottom area cuts through the old reply.
Come in could just be the visit greeting. I am waiting for something after my sentence, not counting that as her answering me.
Still fifty minutes here after that wait. Skip says it keeps the slowdown, but it is the only move that looks like moving on. I want to see whether my words left anything.

I would leave now. I said the listening line, but I have only got Come in and the same barley excuses back. The clock helps me understand the wait, but it does not make me want to sit through it. I wanted a conversation, not just proof that I spoke.

Stopping while walking home from Çoban. The quit wish did not pass. I would close it, not leave it running, and I would not return voluntarily tonight or plan another evening. Saying one listening line was better than saying nothing last time, but I still wanted somebody to answer me. Feedback has both stopping and confused; I selected stopping locally and it filled the box itself. Nothing typed or submitted, consent unchanged.
